'''Pierre Berthelot''' ({{IPAc-en|lang|b|ɛər|t|ə|ˈ|l|oʊ}} {{Respell|ber-tə-LOH}}, {{IPA|fr|pjɛʁ bɛʁtəlo|lang}}; 27 January 1943 – 7 December 2023)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Décès de Pierre Berthelot {{!}} Société Mathématique de France |url=https://smf.emath.fr/actualites-smf/deces-de-pierre-berthelot |access-date=10 December 2023 |website=smf.emath.fr}}</ref> was a French mathematician at the [[University of Rennes]]. He developed [[crystalline cohomology]] and [[rigid cohomology]].
